items.text: A man had three sons. <break time="0.8s" /> And the youngest was called Simpleton. <break time="0.8s" /> Everyone laughed at him. <break time="0.8s" /> And thought he was foolish. <break time="0.8s" /> One day. <break time="0.8s" /> The oldest son went into the forest. <break time="0.8s" /> To cut wood. <break time="0.8s" /> His mother gave him. <break time="0.8s" /> A sweet cake. <break time="0.8s" /> And a bottle of wine. <break time="0.8s" /> In the forest he met a little gray old man. <break time="0.8s" /> I am hungry. <break time="0.8s" /> Please give me some cake and wine. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the old man. <break time="0.8s" /> If I give you some. <break time="0.8s" /> I will have none for myself. <break time="0.8s" /> Go away. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the oldest son rudely. <break time="0.8s" /> When he began. <break time="0.8s" /> To cut down a tree. <break time="0.8s" /> His axe slipped. <break time="0.8s" /> It cut his arm. <break time="0.8s" /> And he had to go home. <break time="0.8s" /> That was the little gray mans doing.

A man had three sons, and the youngest was called Simpleton. <break time="0.8s" /> Everyone laughed at him and thought he was foolish. <break time="0.8s" /> One day, the oldest son went into the forest to cut wood. <break time="0.8s" /> His mother gave him a sweet cake and a bottle of wine. <break time="0.8s" /> In the forest, he met a little gray old man. <break time="0.8s" /> I am hungry, Please give me some cake and wine, said the old man. <break time="0.8s" /> If I give you some, I will have none for myself. <break time="0.8s" /> Go away, said the oldest son rudely. <break time="0.8s" /> When he began to cut down a tree, his axe slipped. <break time="0.8s" /> It cut his arm, and he had to go home. <break time="0.8s" /> That was the little gray mans doing.

한 남자에게 아들이 셋 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 막내는 바보라고 불렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 모두가 그를 비웃었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그가 어리석다고 생각했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 어느 날. <break time="0.8s" /> 큰아들이 숲으로 갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무를 베러. <break time="0.8s" /> 어머니는 그에게 주었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 달콤한 케이크와. <break time="0.8s" /> 포도주 한 병을. <break time="0.8s" /> 숲에서 그는 작은 회색 노인을 만났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 배가 고프다오. <break time="0.8s" /> 케이크와 포도주를 조금 주시오. <break time="0.8s" /> 노인이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 당신에게 조금 주면. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 먹을 게 하나도 없어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 저리 가요. <break time="0.8s" /> 큰아들이 무례하게 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 시작하자. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무를 베어 넘기는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 도끼가 미끄러졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 도끼가 그의 팔을 베었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 집에 가야 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 작은 회색 노인이 한 일이었다.

Then the second son. <break time="0.8s" /> Went into the forest. <break time="0.8s" /> With a cake and wine. <break time="0.8s" /> He also refused to share. <break time="0.8s" /> And his axe hit his leg. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Simpleton said. <break time="0.8s" /> Father, let me go. <break time="0.8s" /> And cut wood. <break time="0.8s" /> His father did not want him. <break time="0.8s" /> To go. <break time="0.8s" /> But Simpleton begged. <break time="0.8s" /> His mother gave him. <break time="0.8s" /> A cake baked in ashes. <break time="0.8s" /> And some sour beer. <break time="0.8s" /> The little gray old man. <break time="0.8s" /> Asked him for food, too. <break time="0.8s" /> Let us sit down. <break time="0.8s" /> And eat together. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Simpleton kindly. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly the cake was sweeter. <break time="0.8s" /> And the beer was now good wine. <break time="0.8s" /> You have a good heart. <break time="0.8s" /> So I will give you luck. <break time="0.8s" /> Cut down that old tree. <break time="0.8s" /> And look at its roots. <break time="0.8s" /> Simpleton cut it down. <break time="0.8s" /> And found a goose. <break time="0.8s" /> With feathers of pure gold.

그다음 둘째 아들이. <break time="0.8s" /> 숲으로 갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 케이크와 포도주를 들고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그도 나누기를 거절했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그의 도끼가 그의 다리를 쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 바보 막내가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아버지, 제가 가게 해 주세요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나무를 벨게요. <break time="0.8s" /> 아버지는 그를 원하지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 가는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 바보 막내는 졸랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 어머니는 그에게 주었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 재 속에 구운 케이크와. <break time="0.8s" /> 시큼한 맥주를 조금. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 회색 노인은. <break time="0.8s" /> 그에게도 음식을 달라고 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리 앉아요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 같이 먹어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 바보 막내가 친절하게 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 갑자기 케이크는 더 달콤해졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 맥주는 이제 좋은 포도주였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 자네는 마음씨가 착하네. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러니 내가 자네에게 행운을 주겠네. <break time="0.8s" /> 저 늙은 나무를 베게. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그 뿌리를 보게. <break time="0.8s" /> 바보 막내는 그것을 베어 넘겼다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 거위 한 마리를 찾았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 순금 깃털을 가진.

Simpleton picked up the goose. <break time="0.8s" /> And went to an inn. <break time="0.8s" /> For the night. <break time="0.8s" /> The innkeeper had three daughters. <break time="0.8s" /> And they saw the goose. <break time="0.8s" /> Each girl wanted. <break time="0.8s" /> To take a golden feather. <break time="0.8s" /> For herself. <break time="0.8s" /> The oldest girl touched the goose. <break time="0.8s" /> But her hand stuck to it. <break time="0.8s" /> The second and third girls tried, too. <break time="0.8s" /> And they also stuck. <break time="0.8s" /> The next morning. <break time="0.8s" /> Simpleton walked away. <break time="0.8s" /> With the goose under his arm. <break time="0.8s" /> The three girls were running. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind him. <break time="0.8s" /> But they could not let go. <break time="0.8s" /> In a field. <break time="0.8s" /> A parson saw them. <break time="0.8s" /> And became angry. <break time="0.8s" /> Shame on you, girls. <break time="0.8s" /> Why are you running. <break time="0.8s" /> After this young man. <break time="0.8s" /> He took the youngest girls hand. <break time="0.8s" /> And he stuck, too. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon the sexton. <break time="0.8s" /> And two farm workers. <break time="0.8s" /> Got stuck, too.

바보 막내는 거위를 들어 안았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 여관에 갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하룻밤 묵으러. <break time="0.8s" /> 여관 주인에게는 딸이 셋 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그들이 거위를 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 딸들은 저마다 원했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 황금 깃털을 하나 갖기를. <break time="0.8s" /> 자기 몫으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 맏딸이 거위를 만졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런데 손이 거위에 붙어 버렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 둘째 딸과 셋째 딸도 해 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그들도 붙어 버렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다음 날 아침. <break time="0.8s" /> 바보 막내는 걸어 나갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 거위를 옆구리에 끼고. <break time="0.8s" /> 세 딸은 달리고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 뒤에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그들은 손을 놓을 수 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 들판에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 한 목사가 그들을 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 화가 났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 부끄러운 줄 알아라, 아가씨들. <break time="0.8s" /> 왜 달려가고 있느냐. <break time="0.8s" /> 이 젊은이를 쫓아서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 막내딸의 손을 잡았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그도 붙어 버렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧 교회지기와. <break time="0.8s" /> 농부 일꾼 두 명도. <break time="0.8s" /> 붙어 버렸다.

Now seven people were running. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind Simpleton and his goose. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon they came. <break time="0.8s" /> To a city. <break time="0.8s" /> With a king and a princess. <break time="0.8s" /> The princess was so serious. <break time="0.8s" /> That she never laughed. <break time="0.8s" /> The king said. <break time="0.8s" /> Anyone who makes her laugh. <break time="0.8s" /> Can marry her. <break time="0.8s" /> The princess saw. <break time="0.8s" /> The funny line of people. <break time="0.8s" /> And laughed and laughed. <break time="0.8s" /> Simpleton asked to marry her. <break time="0.8s" /> But the king did not like him. <break time="0.8s" /> First, bring me a man. <break time="0.8s" /> Who can drink a whole cellar of wine. <break time="0.8s" /> Simpleton went back. <break time="0.8s" /> To the place of the old tree. <break time="0.8s" /> There a man was sitting. <break time="0.8s" /> With a very sad face. <break time="0.8s" /> I am so thirsty. <break time="0.8s" /> And water is not enough for me. <break time="0.8s" /> The man drank and drank. <break time="0.8s" /> Until every barrel was empty.
